about: Second held-out set for mentat/word_stage.py, written 2026-10-30 AFTER the stage had been tuned on word_problems.json (v1), and run once, before any change made on its account. v1 is no longer held out; this is the honest figure. Same scoring as v1.

items.question: A jogger runs at 9 km/h for 40 minutes. How many kilometers does she cover?
How many minutes are in 2 days?
A faucet fills a 12 liter bucket at 3 liters per minute. How many seconds does it take to fill?
A bus travels 150 km in 2.5 hours. What is its average speed in km/h?
A phone charger delivers 18 watts. How many joules does it deliver in 10 minutes?
A book has 320 pages and I read 40 pages a day. How many days to finish it?
A pool of 50000 liters drains at 250 liters per minute. How many hours until it is empty?
A plane flies at 800 km/h. How many hours does it need to cover 3,200 km?
A garden hose delivers 0.2 liters per second. How many liters come out in 1.5 hours?
How many millimeters are in 4.2 kilometers?
A worker earns 15 dollars an hour and works 38 hours. How many dollars is the pay?
A satellite orbits once every 90 minutes. How many orbits does it make in 3 days?
A tree grows 25 cm per year. How many meters tall is it after 12 years?
How many hours are there in 6 million seconds?
A runner's heart beats 150 times a minute during a 45 minute run. How many beats is that?
Sound travels at 343 m/s. How many seconds does it take to cover 2.4 km?
Three friends split an 87 dollar bill equally. How many dollars does each pay?
A 2 kg bag of rice costs 5 dollars. How many dollars do 7 kg cost?
A snail moves at 0.013 m/s. How many hours does it need for 100 m?
A 3 meter tall giraffe is shrunk by a factor of one million. How many micrometers tall is it now?
How many ping pong balls fit in a school bus? A ball is 4 cm across.
What is the weight of 3 liters of mercury?
How long does light take to reach Mars from Earth?
How many times does 7 go into the colour blue?
A car drives for 4 hours. How much fuel did it use?
How many seconds of sleep does a person get if they live 80 years?
What is 15 percent of the speed of light in km/s?
How hot is the surface of a star that is 3 times bigger than the Sun?
How many dollars is 5 kilograms?
How heavy is the number 12?
